items.summary: Recommendation: retain the bounded ultrarough.com prototype only with a finance measurement gate; do not treat it as revenue validation or approve broader rollout. The available revenue window is 2026-09-21: 667 site-tracked affiliate clicks, 1 conversion, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission. AI usage cost is $12.4237 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-25, so matched-period contribution margin and cost-to-learn are not calculable because the cost and revenue windows differ, infrastructure/labor costs are absent, and the recorded conversion is not shown to be incremental or revenue-producing. The only defensible current claim is $0 attributable commission against known AI cost, with full margin unknown. Minimum measurement: a matched experiment window containing page-level exposures, affiliate clicks, orders, shipped items, commission, AI cost, and attributable infrastructure cost; report observed results only after 14 days or 100 new impressions. No forecast, ROI, payback, or causal-lift claim is supported.
